title: RAW UNREVIEWED: local d-core division binds written aiin and ar denominators on f105v
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Within the complete existing f105v.5–7 paragraph, try d|Y as DIVIDE_BY(Y) with immediate right application. The actual forms daiin/aiin and dar/ar give two written core arguments. .5 would express chedy/aiin and okaildy/aiin; .6 aiin/ar and ar/ar. The latter is conditionally unity, not an observed numeral. This replaces the old postfix FIELD scopes and is neither a W94 repair nor a global d rule.

target.complete_unit: f105v.5–7, 30 raw groups per reader; ZL/IT own paragraph and RF corresponding full window
target.claim_limit: One whole paragraph, with two focal complete lines; not two independent paragraphs or confirmations.

meaning_contract.domain: Fix one positive one-dimensional quantity domain Q_D for this local paragraph. A=a=denotation(aiin) and U=u=denotation(ar) are particular positive reference quantities in Q_D, not unit names, classes, material names or numerals. They may be equal; distinct spellings do not force a != u.
meaning_contract.identity: Every exact bare aiin and the aiin core in daiin denote the same a within this local contract; every bare ar and the ar core in dar denote the same u. This is a newly chosen core/whole identity, not a consequence of equal glyphs or equal physical masses.
meaning_contract.other_written_arguments: Let x=denotation(chedy), z=denotation(okaildy), both quantities in Q_D. No value, species, process, old DRY gloss, or equality x=z is assigned.
meaning_contract.operator: D(y)(x)=x/y for positive x,y in Q_D. Output is a positive dimensionless ratio. No nested application of D to a ratio is licensed by this typed contract.
meaning_contract.writer: Exactly d|aiin and d|ar are provisionally licensed internal cuts. In this nominated paragraph, a whole group dY immediately followed by one bare quantity group X is parsed (D(Y))(X). No skipped word, carry from a previous material, or implicit numerator is allowed.
meaning_contract.scope: Only these two d-wholes and the four declared quantity wholes in this paragraph. No new meaning is assigned to dan,dain,daiiin,dal,dcheey or any other family member. This locality is an explicit cost, not a discovered register condition.
meaning_contract.connectors: al and every remaining group remain unknown. In particular al is not declared EQUALS, AND, THEN or a ratio comparator.

additional_consequences: The .6 right expression is dimensionless unity because the declared core and bare ar refer to the same positive quantity u. If ar is only a repeated name with context-dependent different values, that consequence does not follow and this contract has been abandoned.

Both .5 expressions share denominator a, whereas both .6 expressions share denominator u. The cross-role use of bare aiin makes the relation (x/a)*(a/u)=x/u unavoidable under the rule, but no multiplication sign or resulting x/u is claimed to be written.

All four results are dimensionless; a later unchanged written dimensioned result or a written nonunit value bound specifically to dar ar would conflict. A freely chosen new result gloss cannot serve as that check.
The two .5 results need not be equal: repeated daiin now repeats a divisor operation, not a fixed numeral, posting status or equal quantity assertion.
new_costs: Two internal morpheme boundaries d|aiin and d|ar.
One common DIVIDE_BY meaning for d plus four typed quantity denotations with no numeric values.
Exact shared core/bare referents a and u within the paragraph, and one common dimension D.
Immediate RIGHT application and the four chosen local expression spans.
A paragraph-specific construction restriction; no global export.
The remaining discourse construction, role of al and 22 of30 groups are unresolved. No complete translation or compression advantage is claimed.

predecessor_differences.difference: Literal gaps and whole paragraph are retained. Old parse pchedal | qopchdy daiin | chedy daiin is replaced by pchedal qopchdy | daiin chedy | daiin okaildy. No claim that raw fidelity established either grammatical phase. Posting identities, A/B address maps and presumed account differences are not inherited.

W94 assigns whole dair/dain/daiin fixed ratio constants A/B/C; numerator is the current remembered P14 material, denominator the last earlier different material; paragraph forms preserve masses. Its unchanged contract forces A=B=C=1. V instead makes daiin a unary divisor expression D(a), takes its immediate right word as numerator and its internal written core as denominator. No P14 material list, prior-material scan, fixed wholeword ratio constant, cross-paragraph value or conserved material identity is inherited. W94 remains excluded for distinct A/B/C; no rerun or repair is offered.

The mixed material/quality head problem is preserved. V explicitly stipulates one dimension only locally; it does not erase those heads or give all unknown words quantities. The changed argument direction is a new unconfirmed grammar, not evidence favoring it.

Already proposes exactly ar/aiin with d=HAS and qo=NOT. The new content is a locally nominated numeric division function with right operands and self-normalization, not discovery of the two cores. HAS remains a direct incompatible rival with unresolved owners.
The al/dal/ar/dar formal lattice does not authorize semantic d export; whole-only decision and weak cross-family effects retained.

386 owns historical denominator notation but has no target writer; V claims no Fibonacci exemplar or common-bar transcription. GDT909 excludes its fixed at-least-three-step equal-template division chain; V has no quotient/remainder chain and does not reopen it.

known_countercases: GDT1047 already contradicts universal overt right-host daiin: 25 ZL and26 IT marked-paragraph runs. No new universal census is justified. The exact aiin RIGHT rule also has4/3 contradictions.
GDT812 and GDT764 older amount/grade readings remain alternatives; GDT87 notes head-conditioned values need not contradict a common fixed III. No value/axis discriminator is claimed here.
GDT788 does not establish d as measurement or any freely reusable remainder. T773 has a different d provenance hypothesis and real dar/ar versus dcheey/cheey type limits; it is not inherited.
The raw whole paragraph provides no presently bound numeric output or arithmetic equality. u/u=1 is an algebraic consequence of a C0 assumption, not a manuscript discovery.
RF has no own paragraph flags; raw variants elsewhere in the30 groups persist. All four focal pairs are literal and definite-spaced, but those spaces do not identify function application.

frequency_limits.source: Root message during V, existing owned profiles; not recomputed by producer
frequency_limits.claim: Broad distribution prevents quietly promoting a local rule to a universal arithmetic dictionary. GDT1047 supplies exact separate daiin host totals and failures.

design.smallest_next_step: One manual authoring comparison on all30 retained groups: keep the stated domain, core identities and chosen right scopes fixed, compare against old left FIELD and retained reference/HAS rivals, and identify whether any ALREADY BOUND complete-context relation supplies a numeric or dimensional contact. If none does, retain a partial RAW; do not invent al=EQUALS, a unity word, a second paragraph or a calculator. No target test was run in V.
design.decision_changed_by_possible_outcomes: An existing fixed incompatible quantity/dimension contact would reject this local contract; a coherent fixed contact could warrant a finite whole-paragraph draft. Present four derived expressions alone warrant RAW retention only, with no semantic validation.
design.access: Existing owned reports and L target projection only for nomination; no new target admission, image, reserve, mixed raw TSV, external contact, simulator, decoder, global refresh or shared route/ledger/Git mutation.
